title: 学生寮の案内
context: You are a resident assistant giving new students a tour of the dormitory. Listen and repeat only once.
sentences: Welcome to Maple Hall, your new home on campus.
The mailroom is located next to the main entrance.
Each floor has a shared kitchen and a laundry room.
Please do not leave your clothes in the dryers overnight.
Quiet hours begin at ten o'clock on weeknights.
If you lose your room key, contact the front desk right away.
The study lounge on the top floor is open twenty-four hours a day for all residents.

title: 科学実験室のルール
context: You are a lab assistant explaining safety rules to first-year students. Listen and repeat only once.
sentences: This is the chemistry lab for introductory courses.
Always wear goggles when you are working at a bench.
Gloves and lab coats are kept in the cabinet by the door.
Never pour chemicals down the sink without permission.
Write down every measurement in your lab notebook.
If you spill something, tell your instructor immediately.
Before you leave, wash all the glassware and return the equipment to its proper shelf.

title: 美術館のボランティア
context: You are training new volunteers at an art museum. Listen and repeat only once.
sentences: Thank you for volunteering at the city art museum.
Visitors should check large bags at the coat room.
Photography is allowed in most galleries without a flash.
The special exhibition on the second floor requires a separate ticket.
Please remind guests not to touch the sculptures.
Free guided tours begin every hour at the information desk.
At the end of your shift, return your volunteer badge and sign out in the staff office.

title: カフェのアルバイト研修
context: You are training a new employee at the campus café. Listen and repeat only once.
sentences: Here is where you will take customer orders.
Cups and lids are stored under the counter.
Always ask customers if they want their drink hot or iced.
Fresh pastries are delivered every morning at seven.
Wipe down the tables whenever you have a free moment.
If the coffee machine stops working, call the manager on duty.
Before closing, count the money in the register and write the total on the daily report.

title: 図書館のオリエンテーション
context: You are introducing the university library to exchange students. Listen and repeat only once.
sentences: This is the entrance to the central library.
You will need your student card to enter the building.
Printers are available on the ground floor near the elevators.
Laptops can be borrowed for up to four hours.
Food is not permitted in the reading rooms.
Our librarians can help you search for academic articles online.
During final exams, the library extends its hours and stays open until two in the morning.

title: 国立公園のレンジャー
context: You are a park ranger welcoming hikers at a visitor center. Listen and repeat only once.
sentences: Welcome to the visitor center at Pine Valley National Park.
Trail maps are free at the front counter.
Please stay on marked paths at all times.
Bears are active in this area during the spring.
Carry enough water for the entire hike.
The lake trail is closed today because of heavy rain.
If you plan to camp overnight, you must register at the ranger station before sunset.
